newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's IFG says half-yr pretax profit up 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's IFG says half-yr pretax profit up 23 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Irish financial services group IFG said on Tuesday it expected to recommend a final dividend in respect of the full year, as in previous years.

The group said that the ordinary shares of the company were admitted to the official list of the Irish Stock Exchange in August and 32,000 punts of the costs associated with the listing had been charged in arriving at the profits for the half year.
IFG said all divisions of its business contributed to its satisfactory results.
"The second half has started well and we are looking foward to another year of growth," the group said in a statement.
